project.purpose: Own durable external-continuity Tasks, checkpoints, Board collaboration, and exact re-entry navigation without becoming a scheduler, priority authority, Runtime proxy, or domain truth owner.

nodes.label: TaskContinuity
nodes.responsibility: Persist exact Host Task revisions and semantic working checkpoints for external continuity.
acceptance: Exact task.resume can re-enter one revision-fenced continuity point.

nodes.label: Board
nodes.responsibility: Persist collaboration records and deterministic Task route anchors without creating priority or ownership.
acceptance: Board messages remain collaboration records only.

nodes.label: AttentionDelta
nodes.responsibility: Project bounded Board-sequence deltas into exact Task re-entry navigation.
acceptance: Delta consumer must still resume exact Task before acting.

nodes.label: PostgresJournal
nodes.responsibility: Own Host durable object/revision storage using PostgreSQL and canonical JSON semantics.
acceptance: Restart preserves Host revision identity and task/board continuity.

nodes.label: CursorContract
nodes.responsibility: Generalize only the revision/cursor/history-gap pattern needed by future Agent Service consumers without turning Host into their state owner.
acceptance: Consumer can request bounded changes and detect a history gap without full rescan or inferred currentness.

edges.label: route delta to exact task revision

slices.objective: Pressure-test a small reusable revision/cursor/history-gap contract against task.resume and attention.delta without adding scheduler or priority semantics.
acceptance: A consumer can incrementally reconcile changes and detect gaps while exact task.resume remains the semantic re-entry boundary.
slices.nextAction: Write contract tests first; add no new Host authority unless a consumer gap is demonstrated.

gaps: Cross-consumer generic cursor semantics remain a candidate seam, not current Host authority.

review.notes: Initial project-native LEGO planning projection. It does not replace owner-native architecture or evidence.

sharedCatalog.note: Optional shared coordinates only; project-native semantics remain authoritative.
